GERMAN — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #5
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: GERMAN
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Comprehensive listening ‘free-style’ speaking Verbal and non- verbal cues, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Comprehensive listening ‘free-style’ speaking Verbal and non- verbal cues.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Comprehensive listening ‘free-style’ speaking Verbal and non- verbal cues.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Comprehensive listening ‘free-style’ speaking Verbal and non- verbal cues.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Comprehensive listening ‘free-style’ speaking Verbal and non- verbal cues.

   B. Copy random text without understanding Listening for Information Public speaking.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Listening for Information Public speaking.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Listening for Information Public speaking.

3. German for “school” is: (1 mark)
   A. Schule
   B. Wasser

   D. Haus

4. When practising Reading for details, which approach is best? (1 mark)

   B. Good day / hello
   C. Good night
   D. Please

7. When practising Reading for Comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Reading for Comprehension.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Reading for Comprehension.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading for Comprehension.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Reading for Comprehension.

8. When practising Active listening Public speaking, which approach is best? (1 mark)

   D. Use insults to “practise” Intensive reading Extensive reading Reservations and bookings ● Planning a holid.

10. When practising ● Speed reading ● Evaluative reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
